45327-twenty-six-choice-poetical-extract.title: Twenty Six Choice Poetical Extracts Selected From Celebrated
45327-twenty-six-choice-poetical-extract.creator: Unknown
45327-twenty-six-choice-poetical-extract.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Happy the humble soul that takes  And binds the gospel to his heart,  That tastes the love the saviour speaks,  And feels the joys his lips impart. Not Sinai's dreadful thunders roll,  Nor there his wrathful lightning shines;  But peace to cheer the fainting soul,  While grace and glory swell the lines:  Come then, ye trembling souls, with joy.

arxiv-2210-10828.title: Grounded Video Situation Recognition
arxiv-2210-10828.creator: Zeeshan Khan C. V. Jawahar Makarand Tapaswi
arxiv-2210-10828.description: Abstract Dense video understanding requires answering several questions such as who is doing what to whom, with what, how, why, and where . Recently, Video Situation Recognition (VidSitu) is framed as a task for structured prediction of multiple events, their relationships, and actions and various verb-role pairs attached to descriptive entities.

arxiv-2301-04273.title: Heat transport and convective velocities in compositionally-driven convection in neutron star and white dwarf interiors
arxiv-2301-04273.creator: J. R. Fuentes, Andrew Cumming, Matias Castro-Tapia, Evan H. Anders
arxiv-2301-04273.description: Abstract We investigate heat transport associated with compositionally-driven convection driven by crystallization at the ocean-crust interface in accreting neutron stars, or growth of the solid core in cooling white dwarfs. We study the effect of thermal diffusion and rapid rotation on the convective heat transport, using both mixing length theory and numerical simulations of Boussinesq convection.

arxiv-2301-12447.title: Homotopy types of diffeomorphism groups of polar Morse-Bott foliations on lens spaces, 2
arxiv-2301-12447.creator: Sergiy Maksymenko
arxiv-2301-12447.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sergiy Maksymenko. Let ℱ \mathcal{F} be a Morse-Bott foliation on the solid torus T = S 1 × D 2 T=S^{1}\times D^{2} into 2 2 -tori parallel to the boundary and one singular central circle.

arxiv-2303-17419.title: Zero loci of nullvectors and skew zero forcing in graphs and hypergraphs
arxiv-2303-17419.creator: Joshua Cooper and Grant Fickes
arxiv-2303-17419.description: Abstract There is interesting internal structure in the nullspaces of graph and hypergraph adjacency matrices, especially for trees, bipartite graphs, and related combinatorial classes. The zero loci of nullvectors, i.e., their zero coordinates’ indices, encode information about matchings, coverings, and edges’ influence on rank.

arxiv-2309-04633.title: Measurement of the magnetic octupole susceptibility of PrV 2 ​ Al 20 \text{PrV}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{Al}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{20}}}
arxiv-2309-04633.creator: Linda Ye, Matthew E. Sorensen, Maja D. Bachmann, Ian R. Fisher
arxiv-2309-04633.description: Abstract In the electromagnetic multipole expansion, magnetic octupoles are the subsequent order of magnetic multipoles allowed in centrosymmetric systems, following the more commonly observed magnetic dipoles. As order parameters in condensed matter systems, magnetic octupoles have been experimentally elusive. In particular, the lack of simple external fields that directly couple to them makes their experimental detection challenging.

arxiv-2311-04524.title: Validating ChatGPT Facts through RDF Knowledge Graphs and Sentence Similarity ISBN: XXXXXXXXXXXX
arxiv-2311-04524.creator: Michalis Mountantonakis and Yannis Tzitzikas
arxiv-2311-04524.description: Abstract . Since ChatGPT offers detailed responses without justifications, and erroneous facts even for popular persons, events and places, in this paper we present a novel pipeline that retrieves the response of ChatGPT in RDF and tries to validate the ChatGPT facts using one or more RDF Knowledge Graphs (KGs).

arxiv-2311-12725.title: Exponential Asymptotics of Ricci Flow Neckpinch
arxiv-2311-12725.creator: Hamidreza Mahmoudian
arxiv-2311-12725.description: Abstract Abstract In this article we examine the formation of cylindrical neckpinch singularities in Ricci flow in compact manifolds. Rigorous examples of neckpinch singularity for rotationally symmetric initial data were first constructed by Angenent and Knopf in [ AK04 ] , and examples with given asymptotic behaviour were constructed in [ AK05 ] and [ AIK15 ] .

arxiv-2402-07661.title: Combining Evolutionary Strategies and Novelty Detection to go Beyond the Alignment Limit of the Z 3 Z_{3} 3HDM Preprint: IPPP/24/04
arxiv-2402-07661.creator: Jorge Crispim Romão, Miguel Crispim Romão
arxiv-2402-07661.description: Abstract We present a novel Artificial Intelligence approach for Beyond the Standard Model parameter space scans by augmenting an Evolutionary Strategy with Novelty Detection. Our approach leverages the power of Evolutionary Strategies, previously shown to quickly converge to the valid regions of the parameter space, with a novelty reward to continue exploration once converged.

arxiv-2510-16502.title: On the Use of Large Language Models for Qualitative Synthesis
arxiv-2510-16502.creator: Sebastián Pizard, Ramiro Moreira, Federico Galiano, Ignacio Sastre, Lorena Etcheverry
arxiv-2510-16502.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) show promise for supporting systematic reviews (SR), even complex tasks such as qualitative synthesis (QS). However, applying them to a stage that is unevenly reported and variably conducted carries important risks: misuse can amplify existing weaknesses and erode confidence in the SR findings.

europmc-pmc4054843.title: A single mutation in the GSTe2 gene allows tracking of metabolically based insecticide resistance in a major malaria vector.
europmc-pmc4054843.creator: Riveron JM, Yunta C, Ibrahim SS, Djouaka R, Irving H, Menze BD, Ismail HM, Hemingway J, Ranson H, Albert A, Wondji CS.
europmc-pmc4054843.description: Background Metabolic resistance to insecticides is the biggest threat to the continued effectiveness of malaria vector control. However, its underlying molecular basis, crucial for successful resistance management, remains poorly characterized. Results Here, we demonstrate that

pmc-10575319.title: Physiological impact of amino acids during heat stress in ruminants
pmc-10575319.creator: Juan J Loor, Vincenzo Lopreiato, Valentino Palombo, Mariasilvia D’Andrea
pmc-10575319.description: tate translocation of bioactive molecules into the bloodstream. Inflammation, oxidative stress, and misfolding of cellular proteins are physiological hallmarks of stress, including heat and humidity. These processes divert amino acid use away from productive purposes. Inflammation, oxidative stress, and misfolding of cellular proteins are physiological hallmarks of stress, including heat and humidity.

pmc-11271214.title: Acute radiation skin injury in stage III-IV head and neck cancer: scale correlates and predictive model
pmc-11271214.creator: Zihan Zhou, Junjian Lin, Ying Wang, Yunhao Chen, Yang Zhang, Xingchen Ding, Benhua Xu
pmc-11271214.description: PurposeActive radiation skin injury (ARSI) has the highest incidence of acute adverse reactions caused by radiotherapy (RT) in patients with head and neck cancer (HNC). This study aimed to screen risk factors that can facilitate the identification of HNC patients at high risk of ARSI.MethodsData from 255 stage III-IV HNC patients who underwent intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) were collected.

pmc-11403950.title: Medical image analysis using improved SAM-Med2D: segmentation and classification perspectives
pmc-11403950.creator: Jiakang Sun, Ke Chen, Zhiyi He, Siyuan Ren, Xinyang He, Xu Liu, Cheng Peng
pmc-11403950.description: Recently emerged SAM-Med2D represents a state-of-the-art advancement in medical image segmentation. Through fine-tuning the Large Visual Model, Segment Anything Model (SAM), on extensive medical datasets, it has achieved impressive results in cross-modal medical image segmentation. However, its reliance on interactive prompts may restrict its applicability under specific conditions.

pmc-11445435.title: An extrinsic motor directs chromatin loop formation by cohesin
pmc-11445435.creator: Thomas M Guérin, Christopher Barrington, Georgii Pobegalov, Maxim I Molodtsov, Frank Uhlmann
pmc-11445435.description: The ring-shaped cohesin complex topologically entraps two DNA molecules to establish sister chromatid cohesion. Cohesin also shapes the interphase chromatin landscape with wide-ranging implications for gene regulation, and cohesin is thought to achieve this by actively extruding DNA loops without topologically entrapping DNA.

pmc-11534915.title: The influence of suturing and or gluing of perforated Schneiderian membrane during sinuslift procedure on the outcome: a retrospective study
pmc-11534915.creator: Fouad Khoury, Christoph Schmidt, Jochen Jackowski
pmc-11534915.description: The sinus lift procedure has become the most common method for maxillary bone augmentation. The most frequently observed intraoperative complication is the perforation of the Schneiderian membrane. Various treatment options have been proposed for managing these perforations, including the use of resorbable membranes, centrifugated blood products as PRF, or PRGF, suturing, and fibrin glue application.

pmc-11862740.title: Can compassion impact us on a cellular level? Preliminary findings on the effects of a compassion focused intervention on immunological markers and CTRA gene expression
pmc-11862740.creator: M Matos, P Rodrigues-Santos, L Sousa, M P Lima, L Palmeira, A Galhardo, M Cunha, I Albuquerque, P Gilbert
pmc-11862740.description: IntroductionAddressing mental and physical health problems and promoting wellbeing in educational settings is a global priority. Teachers present a high risk of stress and burnout, which negatively impacts their professional performance as well as their mental and physical health. Compassion-based interventions have been found effective in promoting psychosocial and physiological wellbeing.

pmc-12693958.title: RGB-Based Staircase Detection for Quadrupedal Robots: Implementation and Analysis
pmc-12693958.creator: Piotr Wozniak, Paweł Penar, Damian Bielecki, Roberto Vezzani
pmc-12693958.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this paper, we present a stair detection algorithm verified on various platforms, including a real quadruped robot. The proposed approach detects dangerous situations, such as proximity to stairs, in real time, enabling the robot to move safely. In our research, we utilized data collected by a moving four-legged robot, recorded in 18 sequences containing more than 21,000 color images from two cameras positioned at different perspectives.

pmc-13143281.title: Real-time transcriptomic profiling in distinct experimental conditions
pmc-13143281.creator: Tamer Butto, Stefan Pastore, Max Müller, Kaushik Viswanathan Iyer, Marko Jörg, Julia Brechtel, Stefan Mündnich, Anna Wierczeiko, Kristina Friedland, Mark Helm, Marie-Luise Winz, Susanne Gerber, Marisa Nicolás, Tamer Butto, Stefan Pastore, Max Müller, Kaushik Viswanathan Iyer, Marko Jörg, Julia Brech
pmc-13143281.description: Nanopore technology offers real-time sequencing opportunities, providing rapid access to sequenced data and allowing researchers to manage the sequencing process efficiently, resulting in cost-effective strategies. Here, we present focused case studies demonstrating the versatility of real-time transcriptomics analysis in rapid quality control for long-read RNA-seq.

pmc-13213469.title: Evaluating Natural Larvicides: Peppermint and Pepper Extracts versus Temephos on Aedes aegypti and Anopheles stephensi Larvae Under Laboratory Conditions
pmc-13213469.creator: Parisa Mahdevar, Seyed Hassan Moosa-Kazemi, Hassan Vatandoost, Mohammad Mahdi Sedaghat, Kamal Azam, Mahnaz Khanavi, Tahereh Sadat Asgarian
pmc-13213469.description: Background:Anopheles stephensi is an important vector for malaria, while Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and yellow fever. With the increasing replacement of natural insecticides for conventional ones, it is essential to investigate mosquito resistance to these insecticides and assess the larvicidal potential of new alternatives and their comparison to standard larvicides like temephos.

pmc-13256017.title: Pulsed field ablation vs. thermal ablation for pulmonary vein isolation: a network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13256017.creator: Alessia Chiara Latini, Mattia Penna, Andrea Saglietto, Federico Landra, Mauro Chiarito, Alessandro Villaschi, Gaia Filiberti, Sebastiano Carli, Stefano Valcher, Chiara Valeriano, Francesco Amata, Aurora Sanniti, Cristina Panico, Stefano Figliozzi, Massimo Vito Tritto, Gianluigi Condorelli, Diego Pen
pmc-13256017.description: AimsPulsed field ablation (PFA) has recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional energy sources (ES) for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. However, comparative data between PFA and other ES—such as radiofrequency (RFA), cryoballoon (CBA), and laser balloon ablation (LBA)—remain limited.This network meta-analysis (CRD420251054760) aimed to compare outcomes of PFA vs. thermal ES for AF ablation.

pmc-13443798.title: An Earth Observation-based Tier 3 framework for monitoring greenhouse gas emissions from forest fires in Italy
pmc-13443798.creator: Chiara Aquino, Valentina Bacciu, Maria Vincenza Chiriacò, Alessandro D’Anca, Jishnu Jeevan, Sergio Noce, Adriana Torelli, Manuela Balzarolo
pmc-13443798.description: Greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from forest fires are increasingly contributing to atmospheric concentrations of climate-altering gases and represent a growing and poorly constrained component of global carbon budgets, particularly under more frequent droughts and heatwaves. Closing this gap is critical for achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 13, specifically indicator 13.2.

pmc-13504789.title: Assessment of various artificial intelligence applications’ performance in responding to multiple-choice endodontics questions
pmc-13504789.creator: Sevda Durust Baris, Ali Erdemir, Ali Turkyilmaz, Dilek Hancerliogullari
pmc-13504789.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology in the domain of healthcare, including endodontics. This study aims to evaluate and compare the performance of six AI chatbots (ScholarGPT, Scholar AI, ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0, DeepSeek-R1, and ChatGPT-5) in answering multiple-choice questions related to endodontics.

pmc-13536982.title: A Clinical AI-Based System (MoodMon) for Affective Disorders: Algorithm Development and Validation
pmc-13536982.creator: Marlena Sokół-Szawłowska, Łukasz Święcicki, Katarzyna Kolasa, Katarzyna Kaczmarek-Majer, Bradley Malin
pmc-13536982.description: BackgroundPsychiatry needs objective technological tools to address global staffing shortages, stigma, and other systemic challenges. An AI-based system for mood monitoring (MoodMon) was developed along with a mobile app for smartphones to detect changes in the mental state of individuals with major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar disorder (BD) based on acoustic features derived from speech signals.

pmc-13635230.title: Reactive astrocytes mediate toxicity in iPSC derived dopaminergic neurons
pmc-13635230.creator: Naroa Ibarra-Aizpurua, Jon Olano-Bringas, Benjamin Vallin, Lucy A. Crompton, Sally A. Cowley, Nora Bengoa-Vergniory, Richard Wade-Martins

pmc-13640348.title: Virological impact of the programmatic dolutegravir transition at Mildmay Hospital Uganda: a before-and-after cohort study with subgroup and trajectory analysis, 2016–2023
pmc-13640348.creator: Roy Alia Asiku, Conrad Sserunjogi, Collins Ankunda, Susan Kiwanuka Nakubulwa, Joseph Mwaka, Uthman Muluga Wandera, Drake Musoki, Patience Kukundakwe, Ronald Mulebeke
pmc-13640348.description: BackgroundUganda began transitioning to Dolutegravir (DTG)-based antiretroviral therapy (ART) in 2018. However, patient-level longitudinal evidence quantifying the virological impact of this transition from Ugandan facilities is limited. We evaluated whether the programmatic transition to DTG improved viral load (VL) suppression at Mildmay Hospital Uganda and assessed whether benefits were uniform across age groups and sexes.
